checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity: Is the large exponent iteration_count calculation correct for attacker-controlled modexp inputs with exponent_length > 32?
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Identify all entry points where modexp precompile can be invoked (transaction calls to address 0x05). 2. Craft test inputs with exponent_length values of 33, 64, 100, 256, and MAX_UINT to verify boundary handling. 3. For each test case, manually compute expected iteration_count = 16 * (exponent_length - 32) + bit_length(top_32_bytes_of_exponent). 4. Verify the implementation returns iteration_count >= 1 in all cases. 5. CRITICAL: Confirm the multiplier is 16, NOT 8 as incorrectly specified in EIP-2565. 6. Test edge cases: exponent_length = 33 (minimum large exponent), exponent with all zeros in top 32 bytes, exponent with maximum bit_length in top 32 bytes. 7. Verify gas calculation uses the correct iteration_count to prevent undercharging attacks.
checklist.notes: Source: SG-002, asm-008, INV-003, stride-013 | Trust Boundary: tb-007 | CRITICAL: EIP-2565 specifies multiplier of 8 but correct value is 16. Incorrect implementation could lead to gas undercharging, enabling DoS attacks via computationally expensive modexp operations.

checklist.title: Falsification Test: Can the iteration_count invariant be violated through crafted exponent inputs?
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Define invariant: For exponent_length > 32, iteration_count = 16 * (exponent_length - 32) + bit_length(top_32_bytes_of_exponent) AND iteration_count >= 1. 2. Attempt to falsify by testing: (a) exponent_length = 33 with zero exponent - verify iteration_count = 16 * 1 + 0 = 16, not 0. (b) exponent_length = 64 with exponent having bit_length = 256 in top 32 bytes - verify iteration_count = 16 * 32 + 256 = 768. (c) Integer overflow: exponent_length near MAX_UINT - verify no overflow in 16 * (exponent_length - 32). 3. Verify the minimum bound: Test that iteration_count is ALWAYS >= 1, especially when bit_length(top_32_bytes) = 0. 4. Cross-reference with EIP-2565 specification and confirm intentional deviation (16 vs 8 multiplier). 5. Symbolic execution: If tooling available, use symbolic execution to prove the invariant holds for all valid inputs.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0025, Invariant: INV-003 | This is a mathematical invariant that must hold for all valid inputs. Violation could lead to incorrect gas metering or consensus failures across different client implementations.

checklist.title: Verify bit_length calculation for top 32 bytes of exponent is correctly implemented
checklist.test_procedure: 1. Isolate the bit_length calculation function/logic for the top 32 bytes of the exponent. 2. Test edge cases: (a) All zeros - bit_length should be 0. (b) Single bit set at position 0 (LSB) - bit_length should be 1. (c) Single bit set at position 255 (MSB of 32 bytes) - bit_length should be 256. (d) All bits set (0xFFFF...FF) - bit_length should be 256. 3. Verify correct byte extraction: Confirm exactly the TOP 32 bytes are used when exponent_length > 32. 4. Test boundary: When exponent_length = 33, only 1 byte is in the 'large' portion but top 32 bytes includes padding - verify correct handling. 5. Verify no off-by-one errors in bit counting.
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-0025 | The bit_length calculation is a sub-component of the iteration_count formula. Errors here directly impact gas calculation correctness.
